purpose: Explore offline output differences associated with reducing essay context beyond the selected target sentence.

comparisons.question: Does essay context before the immediately previous sentence add observable offline value?
Do the immediately neighboring sentences add observable offline value?
Does any essay context beyond the target sentence add observable offline value?

nextRetestRoutingRule.candidateTargetOnly: No observed new hard failure, no observed new score of 1 in any v4 dimension, no observed case-verdict decline, and every decisive difference is user-calibrated; nominate C for contemporaneous retest only.
nextRetestRoutingRule.candidateLocalWindow: C shows an observed user-calibrated degradation while B does not; nominate B for contemporaneous retest only.
nextRetestRoutingRule.evidenceToKeepFullEssayForNow: B shows an observed user-calibrated semantic hard failure; keep A as the working input until a contemporaneous retest.
nextRetestRoutingRule.inconclusive: Observed differences are mixed across dimensions, order-unstable, or materially disputed by reviewers.

limitations: Condition A is historical rather than contemporaneous and interleaved.
All 20 frozen target sentences are the penultimate sentence of their essay.
Only one Chinese fragment originated from a real user difficulty, and its context was reconstructed.
A single run per condition cannot establish deterministic causality.
B and C are separate sequential runs rather than an interleaved run block.
The historical A run did not record an endpoint hash, so backend identity cannot be fully verified across A/B/C.
This experiment does not test whether task_prompt or target_sentence is necessary.
This exploratory run can nominate a candidate for contemporaneous retesting but cannot directly remove a product field.
